evidence.reason: Measured at commit ef784cf458bb85ff3e182e177aaebcb3d73077ca. IMPLEMENTED: Section 4.19 defines the relation; C12, C13 and C14 are admitted as proposed-v9 with enforcement evidence none. 212 InvocationRecords exist. Two carry an authenticated content-addressed context_manifest_reference and return coverage complete with a named edge; 210 carry none and return coverage unavailable with an enumerated reason rather than an empty ancestor set. Both established edges point at the same artifact, so the populated graph is two edges from one source. NOT IMPLEMENTED: no invocation-to-invocation ancestry, because every edge runs artifact to invocation and nothing composes them. No transitive traversal, which over a single edge class would answer nothing C3 asks. No output digest: the outcome block added under DECISION-20260810-0001 carries stop_reason, token counts, block types and text_chars, and no content hash, so content-addressed output-to-effective-input linkage remains unimplementable. No produced_by edge class relating an invocation to the artifact it produced. SUPERSEDED, recorded rather than removed: this gap previously stated that evidence ancestry is defined nowhere, that all 210 records carry no context_manifest_reference, and that the first slice is a definition rather than code. All three were true on 2026-08-14 and none is true now. The reviewing executor found them stale; the packaging executor had written that GAP-0008 remains open without checking whether its own evidence still held.

name: Evidence ancestry is defined and one artifact-to-invocation edge class is implemented; the graph is not composable
notes: Found on 2026-08-14 while assessing whether C3's ancestry dependency was as close to reachable as its equivalence dependency had turned out to be. It is not, and the asymmetry is instructive. Equivalence was one pure function because Slice B had already built the representation AND populated the evidence. Ancestry has representation fragments, no governed relation, and empty values in the fields that exist.

Section 4.15 states the ceiling and it should not be exceeded: one artifact may mix original observation, copied finding, new inference and paraphrase, so artifact-level lineage cannot distinguish them, and what the system can provide is artifact-level potential-dependence detection rather than claim-level independence proof. A first slice that attempted claim-level derivation would overclaim against the admitted ontology's own statement.

Six enforcement-matrix rows name ancestry or lineage in their dependency column: C3 per-kind equivalence check plus lineage traversal, C4 context-lineage inspection, C5 categorical assessment with reasons, C9 inheritance propagation, C10 VerificationRun with verifier-ancestry check, and C11 admission validator requiring disclosure and named controls. This is the single largest shared dependency among the six manual-mode constraints.

Recorded as its own gap rather than folded into GAP-0005 on the reviewing executor's recommendation. GAP-0005 is about invocation authorization having no record form and about six constraints claiming manual enforcement without artifacts; this is a distinct deficiency in what a constraint's central term means, and burying it would repeat the pattern where a gap's evidence describes several unrelated things and goes stale as a whole.

RECONCILED 2026-08-17 after PLAN-20260817-0001 completed. The reviewing executor found that this gap still described the pre-v9.2 world: evidence ancestry undefined, 210 records with no reference, and a five-step first slice beginning with a definition. The definition is admitted, the slice is complete, and two authenticated references exist.

The structural point is worth recording beyond this gap. The self-model audit reported ok true and verified_current throughout, because that audit establishes index-to-repository consistency and does not establish that a gap's narrative evidence remains semantically current. This is the second time a gap's evidence went stale while the audit stayed green; GAP-0005 was reconciled for the same reason on 2026-08-12. Nothing in the repository detects it.

MEASUREMENT COMPLETED 2026-08-17 and its result inverted the expectation. The packaging executor found the 106 seeds and read them as making produced_by the cheap slice. The reviewing executor checked what would make a seed authoritative and established that the seeds are assertions of the relation rather than retained evidence sufficient to reconstruct it, which makes output digesting the next primitive rather than the alternative to it. The packaging executor verified the load-bearing claim before accepting: INV-8419d4bb8a312acc carries no output digest, and its text_chars of 335 agrees with the artifact's 335-character response, which looks like corroboration and is satisfied by any string of that length.

A correction to the reviewing executor's account: the record does contain the string COMP-0140, but only inside context_manifest_reference, which names the manifest written for that comparison. It is not a produced_by reference and does not weaken the finding.
recommended_first_slice: The measurement this gap previously recommended is complete, and it inverted the expected answer. Recorded here rather than left as a pending instruction. MEASURED at 765e6e22c66736ebb5d35ac5f8a762ba7ed48e54: 106 of 140 comparison artifacts already carry a governed invocation_produced_by relation, emitted by produced_by_references in ai_lab/providers/invocation_capture.py and written at scripts/compare_providers.py. Each names source_id, predicate produced_by, target_id and an evidence path, and each declares itself authoritative false with relation_source future_edge_seed. The remaining 34 are pre-provenance artifacts with no invocation records to attribute to. The predicate registry already defines the inverse, produces, as not emitted in Slice A, so no second predicate is needed to traverse in the ancestry direction. WHY THE SEEDS CANNOT BE PROMOTED. The cited InvocationRecord does not say it produced the artifact, and its outcome block carries stop_reason, token counts, content_block_types and text_chars but no output content digest. An evaluator can establish that the artifact names the record, that the record exists, and that text_chars agrees with the response length; it cannot establish that the output the record describes is the response the artifact incorporated. Agreement on a length is satisfied by any string of that length. Flipping authoritative to true would treat a record naming a property as establishment of the property, which is the pattern corrections A2 and A5 removed from ABS-0004. CONSEQUENCE: output content digesting is the missing evidentiary primitive, and it is a shared prerequisite. It is what would let a produced_by seed be validated rather than trusted, and it is separately required for the content-addressed output-to-effective-input edge class Section 4.19 names. One capability supports both remaining directions. The 106 seeds do not eliminate the need for it; they make it immediately useful. NEXT SLICE, not yet planned: invocation output binding and produced_by establishment. Narrow first outcome: a new invocation retains a digest of its textual output, the corresponding response section of the comparison artifact recomputes to that digest, the existing seed is thereby validated rather than trusted, and one established invocation-to-artifact relation exists. No traversal. Historical seeds are NOT retrofitted: those records have no output digest, and model name, text_chars, timing, session id and the knowledge that one script wrote both files are corroborating consistency checks that do not bind the exact output. Persistence form is deliberately undecided: whether established relations are derived on demand or written as EDGE records should follow the truth condition, not precede it, and the EDGE validator does not currently admit produced_by.
risk: C3 remains unevaluable for any real claim, and the shape of the remaining gap is easy to mistake for progress. Its equivalence half resolves and blocks for every live pair under DECISION-20260814-0001. Its ancestry half now returns coverage complete for two invocations, which reads like success but establishes only that a named artifact reached those executors. C3 asks whether an equivalent executor appears in a claim's evidence ancestry; with no invocation-to-invocation edge, no executor can appear in any ancestry, so the constraint cannot be evaluated however many artifact edges accumulate. The specific hazard is that a future implementation composes what exists, finds no executor conflict because none is representable, and reports independence. C14 forbids reading a negative traversal as independence, and ancestry_edges reports coverage alongside edges for that reason, but the guard is one function's discipline rather than a property of the graph.
summary: ABS-0004 v9.2 Section 4.19 defines artifact-level evidence ancestry and C12 to C14 are admitted. PLAN-20260817-0001 implemented and verified the first edge class: an artifact selected into a retained ContextManifest and rendered into a captured invocation's effective input is a direct ancestor of that invocation. Two InvocationRecords carry an authenticated content-addressed reference and evaluate to coverage complete. What remains is that the graph has one edge class and no composition. All edges run artifact to invocation, so no invocation is an ancestor of any other, which is the relation C3 actually asks about. Neither of the other representations Section 4.19 names is implemented: content-addressed output-to-effective-input linkage needs output digests that do not exist, and an invocation-to-artifact produced_by edge class is covered by no admitted plan.
